commits.summary: ui_window_procs v10/v9: re-frame 4.4 KB of misframed code from the ROM (ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock + 19 windows). Adds lane_uiproc_listing.py, lane_uiproc_framing_audit.py, lane_uiproc_reframe.py, lane_uiproc_measure.py. Also the one-time gate-failure proof: perturbing `cp a, 2:i3` at v10 ui_window_procs.s:8277 made the gate report `kn5000_v10_program 1 BYTES DIFFER`; the line was then restored.

drawbar_panel_ui, ui_mode_handlers, ui_widget_defs v10/v9: re-frame the misframed code, including the PmemOutLGridCheck cases, MidiPart_DataBlock, EffectMode_ByteData_Block1..4 and ~18 stray `.long`/`.ascii` lines that were really code. v9 now carries the v10 text. Audit/reframer fixes; reframe loop driver.

ui_window_procs v10/v9: split ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock into DrawMonoBitmap / DrawLineWithMode / DrawDottedLineWithMode, each with _DeferredPath/_Return/_ParamBlock/_Impl labels, mode entries and headers. Old names are kept as second labels because other lanes' files still use them. Done with uiproc_drawprims_rename.py + .sed.

v10/v9: labels at 117 computed-jump targets, with each offset table documented from the ROM (lane_uiproc_dispatch_tables.py). Five `*_JumpTable` code labels renamed to `*_Evt<code>`. 383 pseudo-mnemonic lines re-spelt to text that unidasm and llvm-mc both agree on (lane_uiproc_respell.py); this includes fixing `andda8 xbc,(..)`, which is really `and a,(..)`.
v7: all 8 romslices (7,652 B) re-spelt as instructions and every misframe fixed; comment-order fixes in the reframer and audit.

v10/v9: 40 SendEvent/ApPostEvent object handles that had been wrongly symbolised as ROM labels (e.g. StringData_APCModeNames_0x160 = handle 0xf00001) are numeric again (lane_uiproc_event_handles.py). Retired 56 end-of-routine alias labels that sat on the next routine; `jrl BoxStyle4_Return` is now `jrl ulongProc` (uiproc_alias_cleanup.py). Evidence headers on MidiPart_DataBlock and EffectMode_ByteData_Block1..4.

v7: ported the v10 semantic layer: draw primitives (v7 had no labels at the B/C wrappers, so they were inserted and their addresses checked), 114 case labels, 408 re-spellings, 20 handles, 49 aliases, and headers with the v7 addresses (every RAM variable here is 0x9c lower in v7).
The last `.byte` instructions became backend raw-operand forms (`cpl_sri_rm`, `lda_dri`), each checked by re-encoding. v10/v9 now have 0 `.byte` lines; v7 has 4. Also records a backend encoder bug.

drawbar_panel_ui v10/v9/v7: named the 11 PsMixer control-type procedures (the table at v10 0xE9F11C, read from the ROM) and their 6 drawing helpers, which were AudioCtrl_DataBlock/_Helper*. About 90 structural labels renumbered under the routine they belong to (uiproc_psmixer_ctltypes.py + .sed).

ui_widget_defs v10/v9/v7: renamed PsEditSwBox_InlineData -> PsEditSwBox_CalcEdgeSwitchRect, PsTrkSw_TrailingData -> PsTrackSwitch_SetBoxFromIndex and DbMemo_TrailingData -> DbMemo_LoneRet, with headers stating what was searched for callers (none found).

measured: Census commands: `python3 scripts/analysis/data_range_census.py --images v10,v9,v7 --json /x.json`, then `python3 scripts/analysis/lane_uiproc_measure.py ` (committed). The measure script sums census grades over the 12 lane files and adds text counts: absurd-marker lines (the lane_worklists regex), numeric branch operands and `.byte` lines. All numbers use toolchain tlcs900_backend@4d7fa4f6b37c. Framing audit (`python3 scripts/analysis/lane_uiproc_framing_audit.py --image --file `): v10 ui_window_procs had 43 misframe windows (336 bad lines) and drawbar_panel_ui 83 windows plus 14 data-holding windows. Now 0 misframe windows in all 12 files. Named or labelled: - 3 draw primitives with 15 boundary labels, in each version - 117 (v10/v9) and 114 (v7) computed-jump case labels - 11 PsMixer_CtlTypeProc and 6 PsMixer helpers - 3 renamed data-named routines Removed or corrected: 56 (v10) and 49 (v7) alias labels retired; 40 (v10) and 20 (v7) false symbols on object handles undone.
gate:
`make gate` passed before every commit. The last run, at 93765f7e, showed all 9 KN5000 images IDENTICAL and every image assembling with the pinned toolchain. The gate was shown to fail once: perturbing `cp a, 2:i3` -> `3:i3` at v10/maincpu/ui/ui_window_procs.s:8277 gave `kn5000_v10_program 1 BYTES DIFFER`, and the line was then restored.

Every tool also re-links an inert mirror and requires byte identity before it keeps an edit. The label-insertion tools additionally assert that each new label sits at its computed address.

`assert_comments_preserved.py --base HEAD` passed on all 12 files at every commit.

The branch verifier from main (23d1cb63), `lane_worklists.py --verify-branch uiproc main s2/uiproc`, passed: 34 paths, all owned files or new scripts under scripts/. No wsa1 files were touched, so gate-wsa1 was not needed.
not_done:
1. v7 has 134 numeric branch operands left (48 ui_mode_handlers, 45 ui_widget_defs, 37 ui_window_procs, 2 drawbar). The symboliser refuses all of them because of the targets, which are in other lanes' v7 files:
   - 80 point mid-line into data (e.g. 0xFCCA30, 0xFDAA53)
   - 49 are R1 (incoherent small block at the target)
   - 3 leave the image
   - Example: `call 0xff0431` is Math_DivideSigned32 in v10 but has no label in v7.
   These cannot be fixed without editing those files.

2. Four v7 `.byte` lines (24 B) remain: `cp (xbc+wa),imm16`, `add xde,(xwa+bc)` and `ld (xde+hl),0` twice. No raw-operand form is known for them.

3. Seven computed jumps have a shape the dispatch tool does not recognise, so their tables are undocumented and their targets unlabelled:
   - AcWelcomScreen_RenderBytecode, a bytecode interpreter
   - DemoMenu_WorkspaceDispatch and DemoDesc_DispatchTable
   - ButtonState_DispatchDSP_InlineData, a byte index into a word-offset table
   - AcIndexEdit_DispatchDSP_InlineData, a 2-level table
   - Draw_StyledBoxWithFrame and DrawPartGroup_TableJump_DefaultCase
   The two `*_DispatchDSP_InlineData` labels are really case code and still carry data-shaped names.

4. In v10 there are about 119 unlabeled code starts right after a ret/jp/jr (34 drawbar, 26 widget_defs, 25 mode_handlers, 34 window_procs). They are either more table targets or dead code.

5. About 800 structural labels (_Skip/_Join/_Loop) are still structural; only the ones inside the routines named here were renumbered.

6. Semantic names for the 11 PsMixer_CtlTypeProc<i> by control kind, and for PsMixer_CtlTypeProc tables in v7/v9, were not attempted; they carry their table index only. What panel control MidiPart_DataBlock and EffectMode_ByteData_Block2-4 respond to (SwbtWr type 0xa8/payload 5 etc.) was not established, and the headers say so.

7. Names that other lanes' files still use are kept as documented second labels: ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock, DrawText_LayoutAndRender_Variant1_Helper/_Helper2, Voice_FactoryPresetData_Code_Helper, ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock_Entry2, AudioCtrl_DataBlock, RootContext_InitEventQueue, and in v7 six `*_Boundary` labels plus AudioCtrl_DataBlock_Return/2/3. I could not retire them without editing other lanes' files.

8. Not done because the files are not mine: the 8 now-unreferenced v7 romslice .bin files under v7/maincpu/includes/romslices/ were not deleted, and the 3 unused positional `.set ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock_0x65/0x3F0/0xBD9` lines were not removed.
leads:
1. BACKEND BUGS:
   - (a) `lda xwa, (xsp+256)` assembles to 3-byte `bf 00 30`, which is (xsp+0): the 16-bit displacement is silently truncated. The disassembler prints the ROM's `f3 fd 00 01 30` exactly that way, so the round trip fails. By contrast, +136 correctly gets the 5-byte form with a warning.
   - (b) The disassembler prints `c1 7f c0 c1` (and A,(0xc07f)) as `andda8 xbc, (49279)`: an 8-bit register code is printed through the 32-bit register table. The encoding is right; the text is misleading.
   - (c) Many forms print as pseudos although the parser accepts plain forms: `ld qwa,0`, `lda xwa,(xsp+302)`, `cp (0xc07d:16),2`, `addw (xsp+12),37`. scripts/converters/lane_uiproc_respell.py fixes them file by file for any lane; it keeps a spelling only if unidasm and llvm-mc agree on it.

2. Object handles wrongly symbolised as ROM addresses (positional pass bb836bf7) exist outside my files too. SendEvent (ui_widget_defs.s) indexes a class table by bits 16-27 of XWA and never dereferences it. Other lanes can run scripts/converters/lane_uiproc_event_handles.py on their files; it only fires on the `ld xwa,<sym> / ld xbc,0x1c..|0x1d..|0x1e.. / call *SendEvent*|*PostEvent*` pattern.

3. Naka-data owners can now make these offset tables symbolic, because their targets are labelled. Write them as `.short Target - Base`: NakaInst_GM_0x50/0x5E/0x6C, NakaInst_ON_E80168_0x5E/0x10A/0x210/0x288/0x3AA, Transpose_String_Plus2_0x5E, Str_PartName_Right1_0x10, TrackName4_Tr1_0x2E, KeyShiftStr_Zero_0x8C, Data_SoundEditorCharsLayout_0x24/0x376/0x386/0x39A/0x3E8, and the Str_No_0x* tables. Each is listed with index -> label in a comment above its jump. Also:
   - The 11-entry table at 0xE9F11C (positional name Bitmap_DigitD_0x11F0) should become `.long PsMixer_CtlTypeProc0..10`.
   - The ext lane's *_EventOffsets tables use the case labels added in ui_mode_handlers.s.

4. Integrator renames in other files, after which the kept second labels can go:
   - display/graphics_text_vga.s: DrawText_LayoutAndRender_Variant1_Helper -> DrawLineWithMode, _Helper2 -> DrawDottedLineWithMode, ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock -> DrawMonoBitmap.
   - kn5000_v10/v9_program.s: Voice_FactoryPresetData_Code_Helper -> DrawLineWithMode_Impl, ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock_Entry2 -> DrawDottedLineWithMode_Impl_Entry2.
   - shared/positional_labels.s: drop the ColorBlit2_LargeCodeBlock_0x* and AudioCtrl_DataBlock_0x1BDA-DD sets. The latter are 4 `ret` stubs at v10 0xF824C0-C3 that presentation_sound_nav.s jumps to.
   Then re-run the symboliser on v7 display/graphics_text_vga.s and kn5000_v7_program.s: they call DrawLineWithMode/DrawDottedLineWithMode/_Impl by numeric calr (9+7+4 sites), and labels now exist.

5. PsGridBoxProc's jump table (ui_window_procs.s, events 0x1e0008a..91) targets 0xF9E6B9-0xF9E90D in psgridbox_routines.s, which has no labels at those points.

6. The ext lane lead about bases 0xFC8570/0xFC8793/0xFC87FD and 0xFC75E3/0xFC7704/0xFC7686/0xFC75A6/0xFC75B7/0xFC7741 is not a uiproc matter. Those addresses are in audio/audio_control_engine.s in v10 and v7.

7. assert_comments_preserved.py aligns with difflib and reports false "lost" comments when new comments are interleaved with runs of identical ones. v7 has 156 copies of "; v10 does not spell this byte either". A true subsequence check would remove this; I worked around it by writing one consolidated header block.

8. v7 RAM layout: the UI/panel variables here are exactly 0x9c lower than in v9/v10 (0xbfe1-0xbfe4 vs 0xc07d-0xc080, 0x8c9c vs 0x8d38, 0x8cbc vs 0x8d58). This is useful for porting other v10 findings to v7.

9. Pointers pushed as two halves (`pushw 0xe9 / pushw 0xde3e` = format string 0x00E9DE3E) cannot be made symbolic without %hi/%lo-style operators in the backend.

10. The tools are reusable for other lanes, and each docstring gives the question it answers and the command:
    - scripts/converters/lane_uiproc_reframe.py with lane_uiproc_reframe_loop.sh (fix misframes from the ROM)
    - scripts/analysis/lane_uiproc_framing_audit.py (find misframes and code-as-data)
    - scripts/analysis/lane_uiproc_dispatch_tables.py (label computed-jump targets)
    - scripts/converters/lane_uiproc_byte_to_pseudo.py
    - scripts/renaming/uiproc_alias_cleanup.py (retire labels that sit on the next routine)
